items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: As a matter of fact, Emanuel and I made it back home.

ctx.x: Is there anything else about the Ida Cox tour? How far did you go, and where, how long did it last?

Well, I went all, all up in Carolina, all up, mostly on the East Coast, Bill. Uh-huh. Mostly all up in Virginia. I think I went all the way to Washington, D.C. Yeah. Because right after that, they got snowbound somewhere, but I was home then, see. Yeah. Because it was time for school open, see, I made it back home, see. As a matter of fact, Emanuel and I made it back home.
Who were your favorite trombone players when you were young? Any, aside from the people you studied with, you must have liked them when you wouldn't
